contract.noHallucinatedCode: always: every returned candidate code exists in jobcode_master.json with the matching type
contract.tracksSeparated: always: occupation candidates type occupation, industry candidates type industry
contract.expectSignals: parsedSignals must contain >=1 of these kinds (field cases)
contract.expectOccupationCluster: SOFT: keyword should appear in some occupation candidate, OR the code is withheld and clarification is required. Aggregate hit-rate is gated.
contract.withholdCodeIfUnverified: documentation: code may be withheld for unverified mapping
contract.neverSilentDeadEnd: must return candidates OR an interpretation + clarification
